data.content_ref: inline:The 7-for-$2 unit rate abstracts away the physical transaction structure (discrete bundles of 7) into a continuous multiplicative model (21 × $2/7). This abstraction is refuted if there exists a target quantity that is not a multiple of 7, or a pricing regime where the atomic unit of sale is the 7-bundle, not the individual pencil — in either case the continuous model overgenerates beyond its actual support, and the correct computation must fall back on integer bundle arithmetic rather than scalar multiplication.
